guide.summary: Live giving: donor-data reduction, cents and ISO dates, ids that join, and the approval-gated write hatch.
guide.content:
# Tithe.ly giving usage

Live Tithe.ly (tithe.ly): real donors and real money.

Account purpose: Weekly giving reports for Grace Church

This connection withholds organizations' payout bank and legal-contact details from every result.

## Giving data is pastoral

Donor names, emails, addresses, and gift amounts are pastoral data. Reduce
inside `execute_code`: page, filter, and total there, and return the
aggregate (sums by fund, month, or donor count), not donor rows, unless the
task needs named people.

## Ids and joins

- Ids carry their kind: `org_` organization, `user_` donor account, `ch_`
  charge, `rc_` recurring gift, `pm_` payment method. Read them from the list
  tools; never guess one.
- Tithe.ly lists charges and recurring gifts only for one organization or one
  donor, so pass `organizationId` or `accountId`.
- A charge carries its donor's name and email, its organization's name, and
  its payment method, so most joins need no second read.
- `list_accounts` covers every account these keys can see; `scope: "api"`
  narrows it to accounts created through this API.
- The named reads project Tithe.ly's records. A field a projection omits, such
  as an account's phone and postal address, comes back from `tithely_api_read`
  on that record's path.

## Money, dates and funds

- A fund is a Tithe.ly giving type: `giving_type` in Tithe.ly's records,
  `fund` in projections.
- Projections give amounts as integer `…Cents` and dates as ISO 8601 UTC
  `…At`. Tithe.ly's own records, from `tithely_api_read`, keep string cents
  and Unix seconds.
- `depositedAt` may be `"pending"`. There is no deposits resource: net amount
  and fees live on each charge.
- A charge a recurring gift produced has `recurring: true`; a one-time gift
  has `recurring: false`.

## Writes

- Every write moves money or changes a donor's records. Bodies are form
  fields in integer cents and Unix seconds.
- `POST /refunds/{charge_id}` refunds a whole charge.
  `DELETE /recurring/{recurring_id}` stops future charges and refunds nothing.
- Card and bank tokens, which `POST /charge-once` and `POST /payment-methods`
  need, come only from Tithely.js in a donor's browser. An agent cannot
  create one.
- Tithe.ly reports most refusals as HTTP 200 with `status: "fail"` and a
  reason but no code. They arrive as `connector_call_failed`; read the reason
  before deciding what to do next.

## Not available

Only Tithe.ly's API v1 is reachable; its undocumented v2 is not.

## Conventions

- **Paging:** a paged `list_*` or `search_*` read takes `limit` (default 25, at most 99) and `cursor`. While `page.hasMore` is true, pass `page.nextCursor` back unchanged as `cursor`; the last page has no `nextCursor`.
- **Results:** `fields` narrows a read's result to the dot paths you name. `truncated` lists the dot paths a result cut for size; the ids that fetch what was cut stay in the result.
- **Hatch:** `tithely_api_search` finds this API's operations and reads no account data, `tithely_api_details` shows one operation's contract, and `tithely_api_read` calls a reviewed read. `tithely_api_write` calls a reviewed write, and every call to it needs approval. An operation without a reviewed verdict is refused.
- **Writes:** a write is sent once and never retried. When its outcome is unknown, read the target before repeating it. Writes take no idempotency key.
- **Errors:** codes come from the vendor's statuses and error facts, never its prose. An unknown id, or one these credentials cannot reach, fails as `connector_call_failed`; this API does not tell the two apart. It documents no conflict.
- **Withheld values:** a value withheld for safety reads `"[redacted]"`, and a write that carries one is refused.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations these keys manage, with their funds (giving types) and status. Fields this omits come from tithely_api_read; payout bank and legal-contact details stay withheld.

order.description: Newest first (desc, Tithe.ly's default) or oldest first. Keep it constant while paging.

limit.description: Rows per page. Tithe.ly allows 100; connecta asks for one extra to learn whether another page exists.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item, e.g. ["organizationId"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List donor accounts by name, email, and id. Giving history is list_charges by accountId; phone, address, and other fields come from tithely_api_read.

scope.description: all (default) lists every account Tithe.ly lets these keys see; api lists only accounts created through this API.

order.description: Newest first (desc, Tithe.ly's default) or oldest first. Keep it constant while paging.

limit.description: Rows per page. Tithe.ly allows 100; connecta asks for one extra to learn whether another page exists.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item, e.g. ["accountId"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: list_charges
tools.description: List gifts (charges) to one organization or from one donor, optionally within a created-date range, with gross, net, and fees in cents.

organizationId.description: Organization (org_…) the gifts went to. This or accountId is required.

accountId.description: Donor account (user_…) that gave. This or organizationId is required.

createdAfter.description: Only charges created after this time: Unix seconds or an ISO 8601 date/date-time (UTC when no offset).

createdBefore.description: Only charges created before this time, in the same forms as createdAfter.

order.description: Newest first (desc, Tithe.ly's default) or oldest first. Keep it constant while paging.

limit.description: Rows per page. Tithe.ly allows 100; connecta asks for one extra to learn whether another page exists.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item, e.g. ["chargeId"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: get_charge
tools.description: Get one charge by id: amounts in cents, status, fund, deposit date, donor, and payment method. Use it to check a charge after a write; tithely_api_read returns the full record.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in the result, e.g. ["chargeId"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: list_recurring_charges
tools.description: List recurring gifts for one organization or one donor: amount, fund, term, and start date. Does not list the charges they produced.

organizationId.description: Organization (org_…) receiving the gifts. This or accountId is required.

accountId.description: Donor account (user_…) that gave. This or organizationId is required.

order.description: Newest first (desc, Tithe.ly's default) or oldest first. Keep it constant while paging.

limit.description: Rows per page. Tithe.ly allows 100; connecta asks for one extra to learn whether another page exists.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item, e.g. ["recurringId"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: get_recurring_charge
tools.description: Get one recurring gift by id: amount in cents, fund, term, start date, organization, and donor. Use it to check a gift after changing it.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in the result, e.g. ["recurringId"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: list_payment_methods
tools.description: List one donor's stored payment methods as type, brand, and last four, for the pm_ id a charge needs. Never card numbers or tokens.

limit.description: Rows per page. Tithe.ly allows 100; connecta asks for one extra to learn whether another page exists.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item, e.g. ["paymentMethodId"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: tithely_api_search
tools.description: Find Tithe.ly API operations by keyword or path. Returns up to 8 compact matches with the tool that calls each; reads no account data.

query.description: Keywords or a path, e.g. refund charge.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous search with the same query.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

matched.description: The request or response field this operation was found by; call its tool to read the field.

truncated.description: Entry labels cut for size; tithely_api_details on that method and path returns them whole.

tools.name: tithely_api_details
tools.description: Read one Tithe.ly API operation's request contract: path, query and body parameters with types and required names. Reads no account data.

path.description: The path template from search, or a concrete path.

param.description: Return only this parameter, in full.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous details call with the same method, path and param.

body.description: Body content type and schema. When paged: this page's properties, the required names it delivers or chunks, and the schema's other keywords on the page that carries them.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

of.description: The piece this text belongs to, such as parameters.limit.

text.description: Part of that piece's JSON; join the parts in page order, then parse them.

truncated.description: Labels cut for size; their full text arrives as chunks.

page.description: Present when the contract exceeds one answer: pass nextCursor back for the next pieces.

tools.name: tithely_api_read
tools.description: Call a reviewed Tithe.ly API read. The operation index checks arguments before anything is sent. Organization bank and legal details are dropped.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /charges/ch_123. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data, applied to each item of an array, after value safety and privacy filtering.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.

tools.name: tithely_api_write
tools.description: Call a reviewed Tithe.ly API write; method and path are stated for approval, and the operation index checks arguments first.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /charges/ch_123. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

body.description: Request body as JSON fields, named as details lists them; form operations are encoded for you.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data, applied to each item of an array, after value safety and privacy filtering.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.
